context.content: Idk if this is the case with your card aswell, but when I worked as a cashier in a grocery store the problem was basically that the mastercards that even say debit on them have the 3d letters, and our machines couldn't read those. This was a big chain store, and there are 2 commonly used types of machine in the NL, I think both can't read them. I got to the point where I would tell germans we did accept the "Deutsche bank" card, because going to the atm in the store to get cash took a full minute.
